name: Surf Excel Grade
description: Premium washing powder matching international brand performance (Surf Excel/Ariel grade)

ingredients.name: Soda Ash Light (Sodium Carbonate)
ingredients.role: Alkaline base, pH control, water softener

ingredients.name: LABSA (acid slurry / sulphonic acid)
ingredients.role: Primary surfactant - the main cleaning agent
ingredients.note: Critical ingredient - do not substitute if avoidable

ingredients.name: CMC (Carboxymethyl Cellulose)
ingredients.role: Anti-redeposition - stops removed dirt settling back on fabric
ingredients.note: Quality ingredient often skipped by cheap brands

ingredients.name: Caustic Soda NaOH (10% solution)
ingredients.role: Neutralizes LABSA into active sodium LAS
ingredients.note: Must be dissolved in water first - never add water to caustic soda

ingredients.name: Water (for NaOH solution)
ingredients.role: Dissolves caustic soda safely before use
ingredients.note: Evaporates during drying - not in final powder, but required for processing

ingredients.name: Enzyme (protease/lipase blend)
ingredients.role: Breaks down protein and grease-based stains
ingredients.note: May need sourcing from Lahore/Karachi wholesalers

notes: Formula includes 4% water for dissolving caustic soda. Water evaporates during drying, final powder is 96% solids + 4% moisture. LABSA concentration is 20% - premium tier.
safetyWarnings: Work in open air or well-ventilated room
Never add water to caustic soda - always add caustic soda to water
Wear gloves, goggles, and mask throughout
Keep children away from work area
Never mix with chlorine bleach - creates toxic chlorine gas
Keep a vinegar bottle nearby for minor alkaline skin contact
equipmentNeeded: Large plastic drum or steel deg (50L)
Small plastic bucket (5L) for NaOH solution
Long steel or plastic paddle for stirring
Fine mesh sieve for final sifting
